description: The three bitmap faces the shell draws with, by role. Each name is an AngelCode `.fnt` descriptor plus its PNG atlas in assets/fonts/ (tools/build_fonts.py bakes them; tools/check_project.py verifies the glyph rects, the atlas bounds and the glyph coverage of every shipped string). Roles are the kit's names: `ui` is the 5 px chrome face, `body` the 8 px prose face, `display` the 10 px heading face.
